# NMI Payments React Component

React component for NMI embedded payment fields with automatic style injection.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @nmipayments/nmi-pay-react
```

## Usage

The styles are automatically injected - no need to import any CSS files. Just import and use the components:

```jsx
import { NmiPaymentIframe } from '@nmipayments/nmi-pay-react';

function MyCheckoutPage() {
  return (
    <div>
      <h2>Payment Details</h2>
      <NmiPaymentIframe 
        tokenizationKey="your-tokenization-key"
        token="your-token"
        elementId="ccnumber"
        label="Card Number"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Alternative: Manual CSS Import

If you prefer to handle styling yourself, you can also import the CSS manually:

```jsx
import '@nmipayments/nmi-pay-react/dist/styles.css';
```

## CSS Modules Best Practices

This library uses CSS Modules for component styling. Here are some best practices when working with our components:

### For Consumers

1. **No action needed** - styles are automatically injected
2. **Customizing appearance** - wrap our components in your own styled containers
3. **Theming** - our components use CSS variables that you can override:

```css
:root {
  --nmi-colors-primary-default: #4c51bf;
  --nmi-colors-foreground: #2d3748;
  /* ...other variables */
}
```

### For Contributors

When creating or modifying components:

1. Create a `.module.css` file alongside your component
2. Import it at the top of your component file:
   ```jsx
   import styles from './MyComponent.module.css';
   ```
3. Use it in your component:
   ```jsx
   <div className={styles.container}>...</div>
   ```
4. Add the import to index.ts so it gets included in the build

## Project Structure

- CSS files are processed by rollup-plugin-postcss
- Styles are both:
  - Injected at runtime (no manual imports needed)
  - Extracted to `dist/styles.css` (for optional manual import)
- CSS Modules are used for style encapsulation

## Complete Example

```jsx
import React from 'react';
import { NmiCardPayment } from '@nmipayments/nmi-pay-react';
// No need to import CSS - it's automatically injected!

function CheckoutPage() {
  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: '500px', margin: '0 auto' }}>
      <h1>Checkout</h1>
      
      <NmiCardPayment
        tokenizationKey="your-tokenization-key"
        token="your-token"
        onPaymentComplete={(result) => console.log(result)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export default CheckoutPage;
```
